abilities.name: reckless
abilities.effect: Strengthens recoil moves to 1.2× their power.

abilities.name: unburden
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed upon using or losing a held item.

kanto.flavorText: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra-long, loping strides.

original-johto.flavorText: It is also called the Kick Master. It uses its elastic legs to execute every known kick.

hoenn.flavorText: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

updated-johto.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

original-unova.flavorText: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

updated-unova.flavorText: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

kalos.flavorText: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Hitmonlee’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on impact and destroys its enemy.

swsh.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
